look_here_first: LOOK HERE FIRST: Five to seven narrow leaflets radiating from a single petiole, then a vertical raceme of pea-shaped flowers and later hairy legume pods. Verify multiple parts, not flower color.
taxonomy_notes: Accepted by Kew POWO; separate from Lupinus subcarnosus and Lupinus havardii.

project_inclusion.notes: Kew Texas state native, but no confirmed three-county project PASS; preserve strict metrics.

morphology_keys.habit: Low annual legume with basal foliage and upright flowering stalks.
morphology_keys.leaves_attachment: Palmately compound alternate leaves; inspect leaflet count and fine hairs.
morphology_keys.flower_reproductive: Pea flowers in erect racemes; inspect banner, wings, keel and calyx.
morphology_keys.fruit_seed: Hairy legume pods; inspect mature pod and seeds.
morphology_keys.stem_bud: Fine hairs on stems and foliage.

confused_with: Lupinus subcarnosus: compare leaflet shape, raceme and pubescence in verified material.
Lupinus havardii: generally taller and more robust, with longer racemes.
comparisons.key_distinctions: Palmate leaflets, upright pea-flower raceme and hairy pods considered together.
